summary: Marketing is in a high-velocity execution phase, juggling the China Going-Global report, BSI report, and TIA conference deliverables, while also advancing the knowledge website redesign and SEO prioritization for Asia Star and Intelligent China.
summaryDetail: The most urgent work this week centers on finalizing the BSI report and the China Going-Global report: TIAN Xuefang must provide raw Excel data for chart uploads, Ira ZAKA needs to review the BSI before it goes to professors, and both Ira and Joseph must give feedback on the key pages design for the Going-Global report, which will incorporate IE branding with a white and CKGSB blue palette. Simultaneously, the TIA conference is heating up: LIU Xuan must finalize topics and share blurbs for Dean Xiang and Li Wei, while Joseph updates the Indonesia emerging market program webpage and adds faculty bio for Jing Bing. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is moving forward with decisions to remove the videos section, integrate videos into topics, and bring indices to the homepage; Joseph, Julie, and the team lead need to provide specific feedback on the current design, and Joker will incorporate it. SEO efforts are also ramping up, with Asia Star and Intelligent China prioritized over US partnerships, and Joseph must create a draft of target areas and focus, while the team analyzes audience profiles and the SEO manager briefs on conversion tracking. Finally, Joseph is managing the massive task of updating meta-descriptions for over 1,000 pages, and the Outlook account lockout issue is being resolved by the user, who must delete and re-add the account on all devices and contact JSB for backend unlock status.
